name: SEOmatic
description:
Ask Claude about your website's SEO and get answers from your real data, not generic advice.

Ask things like: Which keywords am I close to ranking on page 1 for? Why did my traffic drop last month? Who is outranking me, and where? What backlinks did I gain? Does AI search mention my site?

SEOmatic connects your Google Search Console, Analytics, Ads, and Business Profile, plus keyword, backlink, and competitor data, so every answer comes from your own numbers. Ask for a full SEO audit and get a verdict with fixes ranked by impact, each backed by your data.

Then let it fix things. On a paid plan, Claude can prepare SEO fixes, content plans, and articletouches your site until youapprove it in SEOmatic, anr results for everychange.

Free accounts include a monthly allowance of questions, and your first connect banks bonus questions for a full first audit. Paid plans remove the limit.

Connecting takes a minuttic account and pick yoursite. No API key needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SEOmatic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SEOmatic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.seomatic.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SEOmatic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEOmatic provides these MCP tools: backlink_profile, dataset_library, keyword_research, local_presence, serp_competitors, and site_pages.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SEOmatic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SEOmatic in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
SEOmatic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SEOmatic is developed by SEOmatic. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
